d: We are seeking an experienced Legal Counsel specializing in corporate law and corporate governance to join our legal team. The ideal candidate combines strong drafting skills with sound commercial judgment, and can advise management and the board on corporate matters, governance frameworks and regulatory compliance.
Advise on corporate, commercial and regulatory matters, including company formation, shareholder and partnership arrangements, capital changes and corporate restructuring

Develop, review and update corporate governance frameworks, including board and committee charters, delegation of authority, conflict-of-interest and related-party policies, and disclosure and compliance procedures
Support the board, its committees and the general assembly: prepare agendas, resolutions and minutes, and advise on procedural and governance requirements
Draft, review and negotiate shareholder agreements, joint venture agreements, commercial contracts and other legal documents
Lead or support legal due diligence and corporate transactions (investments, mergers, acquisitions and joint ventures)
Ensure compliance with the Saudi Companies Law, Capital Market Authority regulations and other applicable laws, and monitor regulatory changes
Conduct legal research and prepare legal opinions and memoranda for senior management
Liaise with government authorities and regulators, and coordinate with external counsel when litigation or specialist advice is required
Bachelor's degree in Law or Sharia and Law (Master's degree is a plus)
Minimum 5 years of experience in corporate law, with demonstrated experience in corporate governance
Strong knowledge of the Saudi Companies Law and corporate governance regulations
Excellent legal drafting and negotiation skills
Excellent communication skills in Arabic and fluent English
Ability to handle confidential matters with discretion and to work with senior management and board members
Experience with listed companies or companies subject to Capital Market Authority governance requirements
Experience in M&A, joint ventures or corporate restructuring
Professional license to practice law in Saudi Arabia

CMA Qualification Exams: General Saudi Capital Market Rules and Regulations (CME-1B) • CMA Qualification Exams: Compliance, Anti-Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism (CME-2B) • CMA Qualification Exams: Corporate Finance (CME-5A and CME-5B)
